Name: Less Ugly Casino
Author: 0Renciel
Description:
[size=5][u][b][i]Less Ugly Casino[/i][/b]

[/u][/size][size=3]A very simple mod with an [s]unusually long description.[/s] Nah it's pretty short today :p
[/size]
[size=3]Why does the games Casino feel so dead? Have you ever been to one irl?
You'd get a heatstroke if there wasn't air-conditioning inside those places from how many bodies were densely packed in one area. The deafening sounds of the slot machines, the cheerful cries of people winning a turn and the weeps of those who had lost everything.

Anyhow, I just made a small edit to make it a little more lively for my eyes whilst I lose 4 rounds in a row of CalicoJack. Go spice up your gambling addiction! (In game of course :p)
[/size]
[size=3]This has the most simplest coding that is known to man, so though I dread it I know there will be bugs and whatnot that I have overlooked. If you've spotted one, feel free to send a bug report [/size][u][b]AFTER[/b][/u][size=3] reading below. Bug reports from those who has clearly not read the mod description will be ignored and/or deleted![/size]

[size=4][i]Enjoy![/i][/size][size=5]

[color=#ff0000][b][i]Very Important, Read me![/i][/b][/color][/size]

[size=5]What this mod[i] [/i][/size][u][color=#ff0000][size=5][b][i]DOESN'T[/i][/b][/size][/color][/u][i] [/i][size=5]do:
[/size]

[size=4][b]1. Woah, such empty!
[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]2. Woah such empty!
[/b]
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=4][b]3. Give you a better chance of winning
[/b][/size][size=3]Why must I keep losing >:0[/size]
